history_role: Previously inspected 2023-2026 history; exploratory diagnosis, no reselection of the old cash decision
rebalance: Every session target net shares; no-trade band 5% of prior close equity except full exits; sells first, proceeds locked, no borrowing

risk_stop.restart: After cooldown and close equity recovers within 10% of continuous peak; otherwise cash. Applies to finite_state only.

modules.mechanism: Slow reaction to persistent equity risk premium / price trends
modules.disabled: SMA20 <= SMA60 or fewer than 60 observations
modules.failure: Whipsaw, overnight gaps, correlated equity beta; no assertion of independent alpha

modules.mechanism: Short-lived selling pressure within an established upward market
modules.domain: Close > SMA200 and RSI2 < 10 to enter; retain until exit
modules.exit: RSI2 > 60 or close < SMA200; next actual open
modules.failure: Structural repricing, costs, dividends producing price-only oversold signals
Cash lock after a drawdown can prevent recovery; evaluate paired loss reduction and foregone return, never require standalone positive PnL

allocation.static: 0.4 per module split equally by symbol, inactive sleeve stays cash
allocation.risk_scaled: Same module budgets, symbol inverse trailing20 volatility; scale gross down to 12% annualized conservative sum-weighted vol, never up above 0.8
allocation.finite_state: Same risk-scaled module set; benchmark close>SMA200 gives trend/recovery budgets .6/.2, otherwise .2/.6; cooldown overlay; all changes executed in shared account
allocation.ablations: trend_only removes recovery from static and leaves its .4 cash; recovery_only removes trend likewise. cash=0; buy_hold=.8 equally divided and rebalanced with same execution. No best-policy selection.

acceptance.module: Report full-cycle net expectation, PF, Wilson interval, entry month clusters and same-opportunity inactive cash comparator; >=30 cycles and >=4 entry months only a minimum diagnostic gate. Correlated ETF observations are not independent; promotion stays blocked without unviewed evidence.
acceptance.allocation: Pair static/risk_scaled/finite_state and removal ablations at identical capital and costs; report turnover and exposure, no same-risk superiority claim without matching realized risk. Not enough distinct mechanisms for formal multi-alpha admission.
acceptance.total_account: 20% CAGR / 15% drawdown / Sharpe1 are unvalidated research references only. Daily low envelope cannot certify 15% intraday risk; no benchmark-implied promise or forced equity return target.

limitations: Only SPY/QQQ/2800 retrospectively selected ETFs. Not market-wide stocks; historical constituents, delistings and survivorship coverage missing.

Public Yahoo events and US prices, Tencent HK prices. Longbridge authentication, historical lot changes and corporate-action completeness remain unverified. Splits reject rather than invent adjustment.
Dividend ex-date receivables are never spendable; actual payment date, collection fees and investor tax treatment unknown. US 30% haircut is a scenario.
Three exchange-session sale-cash lock is a conservative research buffer, not a certified bank settlement calendar or broker buying-power rule.
Commission/minimum fees are fixed research scenarios; statutory components use dated official rules with conservative per-order rounding. Broker pass-through/charge-date mapping unverified.
Prior20 daily volume cap and 5/15bps slippage are capacity proxies, not opening-auction liquidity or orderbook proof; Tencent volume units not independently certified.
Daily low equity envelope plus exit reserve is not synchronized intraday maximum drawdown. Stocks use 252-session zero-risk-free Sharpe; cash interest not modeled.
Fundamental value/quality, issuer events and macro routing require point-in-time data; no synthetic proxies or returns supplied. FX, short, borrow and leverage disabled.
